speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
question: How enter, and how be adorned?
premises: Whole garland, sequenceless, in self again entered — endless-inner-massed-great-ray-heaped.
Supreme, divine-bliss to grasp, noble-eager, gracious to me may she be — heart-path let her adorn. (Second hemistich recovered — T1 gap fixed.)
inference: Garland entered again; gracious heart-path-adornment prayed.
